audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer labels Vault as 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' in three places and dontsFull[0] is titled 'Fight into her blind'. Vault is not a blind: Riot's E text is a dash to an enemy that damages, slows, briefly interrupts, and leaps her back out to her attack range. The vision effect belongs to Blinding Assault (Q), and even that is a vision hinder — a nearsight — not an attack blind.
audit.why: A player reading 'blind' will hold autos waiting for a miss chance that never applies, and will attribute the effect to the wrong ability and the wrong cooldown. The content layer already has this right ('nearsight'); the full layer contradicts it.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now states what Vault actually does with its 12s cooldown; dontsFull[0].d states that Blinding Assault cuts vision rather than blinding.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four level-chart rows contradict their own why text. whys[1] calls level 2 'your strongest early window' but win[1] is Quinn; whys[2] says the trade math 'stays a coin-flip skill check' but win[2] is Quinn; whys[4] says a Mega Wallop into wall-combo is 'a clean kill' but win[4] is Skill; whys[5] says 'it evens out' but win[5] is Quinn.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Gnar, Skill, Skill, Gnar, Skill, Quinn] and matches every why line.
audit.corrected: Four rows flipped as one atomic group in both layers; the two Gnar rows rated 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer phases were template text with no timings, and no range or cooldown figure appears anywhere on a page whose entire thesis is a range war.
audit.why: Boomerang is 1100 and Blinding Assault is 1025 — a 75-unit edge is the whole reason Gnar can contest the poke at all. Vault is 12s at rank 1, which is the window a Mega commit has to land in.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[1].d, Vault's 12s into phases[4].why and dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Quinn as 'his' and 'him' in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.feeding and report[12].t, while the content layer uses 'her' throughout.
audit.why: Template text whose pronoun was never swapped.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tradeGood and dosFull[1].d; the same sentence is duplicated into breakdown.trading and report[3].t and needs the identical swap.

notes: dontsFull[0].t still reads 'Fight into her blind' and breakdown.cooldowns / report[5].t still carry the 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' label. The title is 20 characters, below the applier's 25-character floor, and the other two are long template strings whose length band leaves no room for the correction, so all three need a manual sweep — the 'blind' framing is wrong wherever it appears. Riot's E text also says Vault 'briefly interrupts' its target, which is a genuine interrupt effect; Gnar has no channel for it to break, so I did not put it on the page.
